🔄 I'd swap the pushdowns for Reverse Pec Deck. The other triceps options in the library, Dips and Overhead Triceps Extension, put even more stress on the elbow. The pec deck works your rear delts and upper back and puts almost no load on the elbow. Tap the card to swap.

⚠️ Keep the pressing light and pain-free today. If the elbow pain is sharp or sticks around, stop pressing and have a professional look at it. Does the elbow hurt during the bench press too?
